text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of her challenge in the Twinkle 
Series, Eishin Flash brought over a 
detailed, three-year schedule she had 
formulated all on her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown, the Tenno Sho 
Spring and Autumn double... It is a 
demanding schedule, but the two of them 
align their vision, vowing to turn their 
ideals into reality together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash mentions that she is 
considering returning to Germany once her 
plans are complete, but she seems fully 
prepared to pour all her energy into her 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Holding herself to a perfect schedule to 
become someone worthy of pride—thus began 
three years with the earnest, meticulous 
Eishin Flash.
